identity.copyTone: Warm, gracious, and convivial, with polished simplicity rather than precious baby-themed language.
identity.tonalIntent: A luminous light-to-mid tonal world with softened, timeworn contrast and enough depth in the greenery and tile colors to feel established rather than pastel.

paletteIntent.dominanceNotes: Let warm ivory lead, with faded blue and greenery as substantial supporting colors; keep lemon yellow and terracotta as selective, sunlit accents.

creativeGuidance: Treat the courtyard garden as an immersive material world rather than a literal destination theme.
Keep lemons recognizable and richly drawn; refinement should come from craft, composition, and color rather than muting their warmth.
Use aged tile rhythm and climbing foliage to provide structure while preserving an easy domestic welcome.
identity.textureDirection: Sun-softened, tactile surfaces inspired by limewashed plaster, aged paper, natural linen, and restrained glazed-tile richness.
identity.creativeDirection: A sun-warmed, old-world Mediterranean courtyard garden interpreted with elegant ease: cultivated greenery, ripe lemons, time-softened tile, warm ivory, and faded blue. The atmosphere should feel intimate and celebratory rather than themed, juvenile, or ceremonious.
identity.typographyDirection: Cultivated old-world serif character with graceful hierarchy and relaxed supporting text; refined but neither ornate nor ceremonious.
